_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Choosing, replacing, or justifying a framework, library, SDK, runtime, database, UI kit, agent tool, or platform by…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "should we use Next.js server actions, route handlers, or a separate API service for this workflow?"
cases.context: The agent has access to the framework-fit-analysis skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is framework-fit-analysis the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes framework-fit-analysis as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against performance-engineering, owasp-security, refactor
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the framework-fit-analysis workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore framework-fit-analysis
Does not route to performance-engineering, owasp-security, refactor when the framework-fit-analysis scope is the owner
Does not invent certification, freshness, or runtime success claims without evidence
